items.1: Copper Golem Launcher is modular: every feature is pluggable.
items.2: Download community modules from Settings - Modules.
items.3: You can switch the theme color freely.
items.4: Version isolation is on by default, so versions never interfere with each other.
items.5: Copper Golem Launcher can inject into any client.
items.6: Copper Golem supports multiple operating systems.
items.7: Copper Golem Launcher is developed by the CopperLamp organization.
items.8: You can do everything and start the game right here.
items.9: LL mods need the LL loader to work.
items.10: LL is a heavyweight mod loader.
items.11: Copper Golem Launcher is written in Rust.
items.12: lip download failed? Make sure GitHub is reachable.
items.13: Zhi is the core author of Copper Golem Launcher.
items.14: lip is the package manager for LL: it installs LL and downloads mods.
items.15: You can download all kinds of content in Copper Golem.
items.16: Want to report a problem? Try filing an issue.
items.17: Copper Golem is open source on GitHub under GPL-3.0.
items.19: The Android build of LL is in development.
items.20: Enjoying Copper Golem? A star would mean a lot.
items.21: Set a custom game directory in Settings - Version; LeviLauncher install folders are supported.
items.22: Downloads support pausing, resuming and retrying.
items.23: Allocate memory and add launch arguments in Settings - Launch.
items.24: Drag the title bar to move the window.
items.25: Each version keeps its own settings: editor mode, debug console and launch args are configured separately.
items.26: Stuck on something? Enable logs and debug output in Settings - Launch.
